name: North Lanarkshire
title: North Lanarkshire —
tagline: Industrial heritage, Summerlee and the home of Irn-Bru.
summary: North Lanarkshire is a former heartland of coal, iron and steel, with Motherwell, Coatbridge, Airdrie and Cumbernauld. Summerlee Museum tells the story of the ironworks.
Irn-Bru, Scotland's other national drink, is made in Cumbernauld.

community.intro: Lanarkshire's miners and steelworkers emigrated to Canada, the US and Australia, and their descendants keep the memory alive.
